home.title: Kundli and matching reports
home.body: A printable PDF of your chart or of a match, computed by the same engine as our free tools. Free sample available.

blurb.kundli_report: Your birth chart in print: charts, planets, houses, nakshatras, Vimshottari dasha, doshas and numerology, all from one saved kundli.
blurb.matching_report: Two saved kundlis compared: both charts, the full Ashtakoota table with the points for each koota, and Mangal dosha for both.

kundli_report: Birth details and panchang at birth
Planets: sign, degree, nakshatra, pada, lord, house, retrograde
Nakshatras of the Moon, Sun and ascendant
Vimshottari dasha: all mahadashas with dates; antardashas of the current and next mahadasha
Doshas: Mangal, Kaal Sarp and Sade Sati, with the table's review status
Method and sources: ayanamsha, node, houses, engine version
matching_report: Both charts, North and South Indian style
Ashtakoota table: all 8 kootas with points
Total score and Mangal dosha compatibility
Method and sources: ayanamsha, node, houses, engine version
